description:
Ordinary office worker 'Ji-ho' is lethargic, and dating with girlfriend 'Solbin' feels boring..  
At that time, he became acquainted with the ‘new’ YouTuber ‘Eunyul’, who had novelty and excitement.  
His emotions explode like fireworks.  
"I can't do this... I can't.." But his heart keeps going that way...
